simple.meaning: סֹבֶל (çôbel) is a Hebrew object word meaning “load (figuratively).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 9:3. The surrounding context includes land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סֹבֶל (H5448) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: סֹבֶל (çôbel) / H5448 is traced through Isaiah 9:3, Isaiah 10:27, Isaiah 14:25 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H5448. sobel or subbal [ סֹ֫בֶל ] noun masculine Isa 10:27 burden (always figurative of burden of tyranny); — only suffix סֻבְּלוֺ , 10:27 (see references on סֻבְּכוֺ , [ סְבֹךְ ]), ס ׳עֹל 9:3 ; 14:25 (in all conceived as burden resting on shoulders).

occurrences.englishText: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
